PLAN "Postpartum On-Ramp 4-Week - Home with Light Dumbbells"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name " rebuild baseline strength safely postpartum"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Acclimatisation A":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Acclimatisation B":
        warmup:
          walking 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lunge 3x10 each leg rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 28m "Acclimatisation C":
        warmup:
          walking 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hinge_hinge_note 0
          deadlift 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1 minute

    NOTE: Week 1 sessions focus on tempo, technique, and light loading; no jumping, impact, or high-intensity effort.

    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Foundation Builders A":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          push_up_knee_variation 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Foundation Builders B":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          reverse_lunge 3x10 each leg rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          reverse_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 32m "Foundation Builders C":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 2 minutes

    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Stability & Load Progress A":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 38m "Stability & Load Progress B":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lunge 3x10 each leg rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Stability & Load Progress C":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2 minutes

    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Prep for Progression A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 42m "Prep for Progression B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lunge 3x10 each leg rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pull_down substitute_note 0
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 44m "Prep for Progression C":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_release 2 minutes

# End of plan

Notes:
- Exercises chosen are within canonical vocabulary; where a mismatch could occur, substitutions were made for safe postpartum progression.
- Week 1 is an acclimation week with lower volumes and lighter effort, focusing on form and body awareness.
- No jumping, high-impact plyometrics, or abrupt maximal loads included.
- Rest periods scale with progression; 60–90 seconds for early weeks, up to 90 seconds in later weeks as volume increases.

plan.name: Postpartum On-Ramp 4-Week - Home with Light Dumbbells
